$comment: A STRUCTURAL EXAMPLE, NOT A WORKING RECIPE.
Leading underscore means this file is never loaded by the app and cannot be published.
The methodology below is deliberately marked TODO rather than filled in with plausible
table names — a template that looks authoritative is worse than one that obviously is not,
because someone will copy it and ship a definition nobody verified.
To write a real recipe: copy this, rename to <id>.json, fill in every TODO against the
actual warehouse, get it reviewed, and add the id to MANIFEST.json.
